lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs, typically containing 4 to 6 spots per column, arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a distinct lattice or anchor-node configuration on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four smaller accompanying fish (likely remoras) visible beneath the ventral and pectoral regions of the shark.
